Sqawk
Sqawk is an SQL-based command-line tool for processing delimiter-separated files (CSV, TSV, etc.), inspired by the classic
awk
command. It loads data into in-memory tables, executes SQL queries against these tables, and writes the results back to the console or files.
Features
Powerful SQL Query Engine
Support for SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations
WHERE clause filtering with comparison operators
DISTINCT keyword for removing duplicate rows
ORDER BY for sorting results (ASC/DESC)
Column aliases with the AS keyword
Aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX)
GROUP BY for data aggregation
Multi-Table Operations
Cross joins between tables
INNER JOIN with ON conditions for precise join criteria
Support for joining multiple tables
Table-qualified column names
Smart Data Handling
Automatic type inference (Integer, Float, Boolean, String)
Type coercion for comparisons
Null value support
File Format Support
Process CSV, TSV, and custom-delimited files
Custom field separator support with -F option (like awk)
Fast in-memory execution
Process multiple files in a single command
Table name customization
Chain multiple SQL statements
Safe Operation
Doesn't modify files without explicit request (--write flag)
Only writes back tables that were modified
Verbose mode for operation transparency
Installation
cargo install sqawk
Usage
Basic SELECT query
sqawk -s
"
SELECT * FROM data
"
data.csv
This loads
data.csv
into an in-memory table called "data" and performs a SELECT query.
Filtering data with WHERE clause
sqawk -s
"
SELECT * FROM employees WHERE salary > 50000
"
employees.csv
Updating rows
sqawk -s
"
UPDATE data SET status = 'active' WHERE id = 5
"
data.csv --write
This updates the status field to 'active' for rows with id = 5 and saves the changes back to data.csv.
Deleting rows
sqawk -s
"
DELETE FROM data WHERE id = 5
"
data.csv --write
This removes rows with id = 5 and saves the changes back to data.csv.
Multiple operations
sqawk -s
"
UPDATE data SET status = 'inactive' WHERE last_login < '2023-01-01'
"
-s
"
DELETE FROM data WHERE status = 'inactive' AND last_login < '2022-01-01'
"
-s
"
SELECT * FROM data
"
data.csv --write
This executes multiple SQL statements in sequence: first marking recent inactive accounts, then removing very old inactive accounts, and finally showing the results.
Multiple files
sqawk -s
"
SELECT * FROM users
"
-s
"
SELECT * FROM orders
"
users.csv orders.csv
Finding unique values with DISTINCT
#
Get unique values from a single column
sqawk -s
"
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products
"
products.csv
#
Get unique combinations of columns
sqawk -s
"
SELECT DISTINCT department, role FROM employees
"
employees.csv
#
Use DISTINCT with ORDER BY for sorted unique values
sqawk -s
"
SELECT DISTINCT region FROM customers ORDER BY region
"
customers.csv
Join tables with INNER JOIN
#
Join users and orders using INNER JOIN with ON condition
sqawk -s
"
SELECT users.name, orders.product_id, orders.date FROM users INNER JOIN orders ON users.id = orders.user_id
"
users.csv orders.csv
#
Join with additional WHERE filtering
sqawk -s
"
SELECT users.name, orders.product_id, orders.date FROM users INNER JOIN orders ON users.id = orders.user_id WHERE orders.product_id > 100
"
users.csv orders.csv
#
Using DISTINCT with JOINs to find unique customer-product pairs
sqawk -s
"
SELECT DISTINCT users.name, products.name FROM users INNER JOIN orders ON users.id = orders.user_id INNER JOIN products ON orders.product_id = products.product_id
"
users.csv orders.csv products.csv
Custom field separators
#
Process a tab-delimited file (TSV)
sqawk -F
'
\t
'
-s
"
SELECT * FROM employees WHERE salary > 70000
"
employees.tsv
#
Process a colon-delimited file
sqawk -F
'
:
'
-s
"
SELECT id, name, email FROM contacts
"
contacts.txt
Verbose mode
sqawk -s
"
SELECT * FROM data WHERE value > 100
"
data.csv -v
Write mode
sqawk -s
"
DELETE FROM data WHERE status = 'expired'
"
data.csv --write
By default, sqawk doesn't modify input files. Use the
--write
flag to save changes back to the original files.
Documentation
For more detailed information, see:
User Guide
- Complete guide to installing and using Sqawk
SQL Language Reference
- Comprehensive guide to Sqawk's SQL dialect
In-Memory Database Architecture
- Technical details a

data.title: FromSoft's singular mech game Chromehounds is back online
data.author: pabs3
data.article_summary: 文章主要介绍了FromSoftware的一款被低估的机甲游戏《Chromehounds》正在被粉丝社区复活。该游戏最初于2010年因服务器关闭而无法在线游玩，但最近在一些热心粉丝和模组制作者的努力下，重新实现了6v6的多人对战。游戏特色在于团队协作、自定义机甲和独特的非对称角色，需要玩家通过语音交流来协调战术，特别是在争夺通讯塔和领土战争中。尽管《Chromehounds》当年并未大热，但其忠实粉丝一直致力于让它重现生机。模组制作者ImagineBeingAtComputers通过一系列技术探索，最终成功恢复了游戏的在线功能，让这款老游戏再次焕发活力。文章还提到，类似《Phasmophobia》和《Lethal Company》这样的游戏证明，只要有足够吸引力，玩家仍愿意参与公共语音交流。

• [aetherspawn] 认为《MechWarrior Online》在网络代码公平性方面表现出色，尤其是在全球玩家ping值不同的情况下，经过长时间调整达到了较为公平的状态。他特别提到机甲有多个独立 hitbox，细微的网络延迟可能影响游戏公平性。

• [gimmeThaBeet] 表达了对《Chromehounds》的怀旧情感，认为其三方势力冲突和独特的文明美学设计在当时非常超前。他还提到《Chromehounds》之前已有《Armored Core》，认为FromSoftware在机甲游戏领域早有积累。

• [reverendsteveii] 讨论了不同机甲游戏的操控风格，偏好《BattleTech》中慢速、重装甲的机甲，而非《Armored Core》中更为灵活、滑溜的机甲，强调了对特定游戏机制（如机甲移动速度和武器瞄准时间）的个人喜好。

• [typesarecool] 表达了对《Chromehounds》重制或续作的期待，提到自己过去只能玩单人模式但仍非常喜欢这款游戏，显示了对该游戏的怀念与支持。

• [ninetyninenine] 认为最出色的机甲游戏是《Virtual On》，特别称赞其独特的游戏机制，如火箭侧滑闪避，认为其他游戏（包括《Armored Core》）未能复制这种体验，暗示了《Virtual On》在操作感和游戏性上的独特地位。

• [conception] 提到了《Steel Battalion》和其独特的大型控制器，开玩笑地问是否有人想为超级粉丝编写新内容，暗示了某些老派机甲游戏玩家的怀旧需求。

• [pawanjswal] 简单地表达了对《Chromehounds》复活的感慨，情感上偏向怀旧和支持。

• [tra3] 提到曾玩过《War Robots》，但后来意识到该游戏的“付费获胜”（pay-to-win）机制，暗示对这种商业模式的不满。

• [absurdo] 以幽默方式提到了《Chromehounds》和《Chromelords》之间的关系，可能在暗示某种非正式的“精神续作”或玩家间的文化传承。

争议焦点：
• 不同玩家对机甲游戏类型的偏好不同，尤其是对机甲移动和战斗风格的看法存在分歧。例如，[reverendsteveii] 更喜欢慢速、重装甲的《BattleTech》风格，而其他人可能更偏好《Armored Core》或《Virtual On》的灵活操作。
• 对游戏公平性和网络代码的关注也是一个讨论重点，特别是在全球玩家同场竞技时如何保证公平性（[aetherspawn] 的观点）。

Hello! Apologies for the late issue, but this story came together last minute, on account of capital-L Life, and also because the subject is developing
fast
. Hopefully it's worth the wait! I've got an exclusive interview for you on a shit-hot community project to resurrect a FromSoftware game that was criminally underappreciated in its day. I mean, that's practically all FromSoftware games, but this one was just born in the wrong time and place — I think it would be a substantial hit on Steam in the year 2025.
But I'm getting ahead of myself, while also being behind. So let's jump right into it! It's big stompy robot time.
The Big One
1. Bringing back the FromSoftware mech game that was a decade ahead of its time
On Wednesday, Resetera member wwm0nkey
posted a thread
I've been waiting to see for years:
"Fans are working to bring From Software's ChromeHounds back online."
But the news is actually even better than that: they've already succeeded. For the first time since Sega shut down the servers in 2010, FromSoftware's most inspired mech game is playable again, with a small group of diehard fans currently battling it out in up to 6v6 multiplayer matches.
The tl;dr on Chromehounds: it's a team-based, PvP mech game with customizable machines and unique asymmetrical roles that demanded true collaboration to succeed. Heavy mechs too slow to maneuver around the battlefield had to sit on the backlines, firing off artillery shots at the direction of the frontline troops. Commanders held squads together, dishing out information and orders. Capturing communication towers was the only way to keep comms open, and their limited range meant pushing into enemy territory likely meant intense, high risk radio silence. Battles fed into a meta-level conflict between warring nations, with enough wins for one side eventually resulting in conquest of a capital city and a reset of the whole war. This video from YouTube channel Save Data breaks it all down in more detail, and what made it so unique at the time — which honestly still applies today.
Chromehounds was, of course, never big, but the players who loved it
really
loved it. What I found most fascinating about it (from a distance, because it never made it off my "I should try that sometime" list in the Xbox 360 era) was how battles hinged on the implementation of voice chat, which was still novel and exciting on consoles then. Everyone was guaranteed to have that dinky 360 headset, but few games treated communication as a malleable mechanic. Empowering certain players to distribute information and drawing stark boundaries between where you could and couldn't reach your team flooded the tactical playspace with so many possibilities even before you got to customizing mechs or outshooting your enemies.
There was a beautiful but brief window after the launch of the Xbox 360 in late 2005 when developers were experimenting with these sorts of voice chat ideas, and of course FromSoftware would come up with a fascinating (and underappreciated) game built around it. Two years after Chromehounds came out, Microsoft effectively made games like it extinct by releasing Party Chat, which allowed everyone to skip out on public chat and talk only with their friends.
While the situation is much the same now, with most of us sequestered in private Discords whenever we play, I think the success of games like Phasmophobia and Lethal Company — and the audience for games on PC now being bigger and more varied than ever — shows that people
will
hop in public voice for a compelling enough idea.
Likewise, the diehards who truly love Chromehounds will, to this day, jump through the hackiest set of hoops imaginable for a chance to experience its magic once again.
"I'm glad people trusted me, because I don't know if I would've quite trusted me up to that point. 'Hey, this 15-year-old game is running; all you have to do is run this EXE that Windows says is bad," jokes ImagineBeingAtComputers, the modder behind Chromehounds' comeback.
ImagineBeingAtComputers set up a Discord server called OpenCOMBAS in 2023 after setting out to try to revive the game and eventually finding a developer debug build. "What this gets us isn't quite clear yet, but it definitely gets us closer," he wrote in the server's announcement channel. Then a year went by. The debug build of the game granted him access to lots of useful information about how Chromehounds worked, but it wasn't the silver bullet it may sound like. In May 2024 he posted in the Discord that he was at an impassable dead end, with no idea how to revive the game's online multiplayer.

data.title: Yes-rs: A fast, memory-safe rewrite of the classic Unix yes command
data.author: ericdiao
data.article_summary: "yes-rs" 是一个用 Rust 重写的 Unix 经典命令 `yes`，具有更高的内存安全性和性能。原版的 `yes` 命令用 C 编写，存在内存安全问题和性能局限。而 "yes-rs" 具有以下特点：内存安全、速度极快、支持零成本抽象、可实现无畏并发，并完全使用 Rust 编写，易于通过 Cargo 安装和管理。用户可以通过 `cargo install yes-rs` 安装，并用其输出 "y" 或其他自定义字符串。该项目旨在展示 Rust 在系统编程中的优势。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕Rust项目"yes-rs"的代码规模、复杂性、技术方向、以及一些幽默评论的讨论。

不同观点：
• **alberth**认为该项目的代码量是GNU版本的26倍，管理和维护成本更高，可能还会引入新的工具链，对成本效益的分析将很有趣。
• **selcuka**通过一系列幽默的错误处理示例，暗示Rust在错误处理上比C++更具优势，但也提到了一些看似不可能发生的错误。
• **mjmas**提到该项目将在6个月后被放弃，并推荐了几个替代项目，这些项目使用了不同的架构和依赖。
• **tptacek**以讽刺口吻建议将项目拆分为12个不同的crate，暗示项目可能过度复杂化。
• **kidmin**提到一个用Java编写的企业级项目，暗示当前Rust项目的复杂性和必要性可能被夸大。
• **layer8**指出代码中缺少本地化处理，并以乌兹别克语的“no”为例，认为Rust的类型系统未捕捉到这种潜在错误。
• **adastra22**批评了一些人在未阅读源代码前就发表评论。
• **thadt**对项目的量子抵抗安全声明表示怀疑，指出代码中未见任何后量子算法，并提到一些未使用的优化标志，暗示这些可能是未来解决问题的路线图。
• **sethops1**建议增加原生Kubernetes集成和Helm chart支持，以提升项目的实用性。
• **k3vinw**赞赏项目的幽默和奉献精神，提到项目问题也得到了同等重视。
• **juped**以幽默方式提到隐藏不安全的代码，并表示对量子相关的幽默不太理解。
• **csmantle**认为该项目展示了Rust不该成为的样子，暗示其过度复杂和不必要的设计。
• **pawanjswal**表示非常喜欢项目的“Rust能量”，赞赏其夸张的风格。
• **otikik**幽默地表示期待项目2.0版加入AI功能。
• **rurban**认为这是一个对“疯狂”人群的实用玩笑。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于项目的复杂性和实用性。一些评论者认为项目过度复杂，而另一些评论者则欣赏其幽默和夸张的风格。
• 对项目的本地化和错误处理也存在一定讨论，特别是对Rust类型系统未能捕捉潜在错误的批评。
• 量子抵抗安全声明和未来路线图的未实现部分也引发了质疑。

  ◦ [coderag] 建议增加Strava集成，以便利用现有的Strava网络。
  ◦ [deadbabe] 认为该应用也可以用于可视化GitHub提交记录。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何创建和管理超文本知识库，以及相关工具的可持续性和易用性。

不同观点：
• [coderatlarge] 指出，许多科学家、学生和爱好者希望创建自己的基于标签的超文本知识库，但历史上所需的工具组合非常复杂，尤其是Gerby软件及其依赖项已难以在现代环境中构建，这引发了对其长久性的质疑。

• [pastage] 认为，Web在其发展历程中经历了三次重大冲击：弹出式广告、SEO内容农场和当前的LLM生成内容泛滥。尽管不热衷于使用TeX进行写作，但认为像Gerby这样的项目通过专注于发布知识图谱的工具改进是有价值的。同时，强调所见即所得（wysiwyg）的工具因其易用性会始终占据优势。

补充讨论：
• [pastage] 提到了对TeX在写作方面的保留意见，认为复杂的Markdown类似于TeX，但强调在布局方面TeX仍然是合适的选择。
• [pastage] 进一步指出，当前LLM生成内容的泛滥对Web的原始生态构成了威胁，这成为改进知识库工具的一个动机。
• 争议的焦点在于工具的复杂性与易用性之间的平衡。一方面是像Gerby这样功能强大但依赖复杂的工具，另一方面是所见即所得的工具因其用户友好性更有可能被广泛采用。

总结来看，讨论围绕着创建和管理超文本知识库的工具复杂性、可持续性和用户体验展开，涉及到历史工具的局限性与现代需求之间的矛盾。

data.title: SVG favicons in action
data.author: stefankuehnel
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了如何为网站创建支持暗模式的SVG favicon。虽然SVG favicon在缩放和适应不同背景方面有优势，但手动编辑SVG文件较为繁琐。通常，favicon应为网站Logo的缩小版，且需要根据背景亮度调整图标颜色以确保对比度。创建SVG favicon的关键在于使用CSS媒体查询（`prefers-color-scheme`）来实现暗模式支持，通过在SVG中嵌入样式来改变图标颜色。尽管一些设计工具可以帮助创建SVG，但手动编写代码仍是前端开发的常见方式。最终目标是确保favicon在亮、暗模式下都清晰可见并与网站整体设计一致。

主要讨论点：SVG favicons 的支持情况及其实际应用

不同观点：

• **move-on-by** 表达了对 SVG favicons 的喜爱，但指出由于 Safari 对 SVG 图标的支持不完善，使其不是一个理想的选择。

• **staplung** 提到了一个有趣的实验性项目“Defender of the Favicon”，虽然目前似乎不再有效，但展示了 favicon 的一些创造性用法。

44083235.article_content:
Get affordable and hassle-free WordPress hosting plans with Cloudways —
start your free trial today
.
Ever heard of favicons made with SVG? If you are a regular reader of CSS-Tricks, you probably have. But does your website actually use one?
The task is more non-trivial than you might think. As we will see in this article, creating a useful SVG favicon involves editing an SVG file manually, which is something many of us try to avoid or are uncomfortable doing. Plus, we are talking about a
favicon
. We can spend a few hours playing with a hot new CSS framework. But a favicon? It sometimes feels too small to be worth our time.
This article is about creating an SVG favicon
for real
. If you’re in front of your laptop, get the vector file of a logo ready. By the end of your (active!) reading, your SVG favicon will be ready to shine.
Why an SVG favicon at all?
We are here for the “how” but it’s worth reflecting: what is an SVG favicon even good for? We already have other file types that handle this, right?
SVG is a vector format. As such, it has valuable features over raster formats, including those typically used for favicons, like PNG. SVGs scale and are often more compact than its binary cousins because, well, they’re just code!
Everything is drawn in numbers and letters!
That’s good news, but how does this help our favicon? Desktop favicons are small,
at most 64×64
. And you can ship your
icons in several resolutions
. Scaling is a feature we don’t really need here.
File size is another source of disappointment. While SVG has a clear edge over a high resolution PNG file, the tables turn in low resolution. It is common for a 48×48 PNG favicon to result in a smaller file size than its SVG equivalent.
Yet, we have a good reason to pay attention to SVG favicon:
dark mode support
.
Dark mode
has received a lot of attention recently. You may even have implemented dark mode for your own websites. What does that mean for favicon? It means the ability to show different icons based on the brightness of the browser tab’s background.
We are going to prepare such an icon.
How to create an SVG favicon (in theory)
Getting dark mode support for an SVG favicon relies on a CSS trick (10 points to Gryffindor), namely that we can drop a
<style>
tag right inside SVG, and use a media query to detect the user’s current theme preference. Something like this:
<svg>
<style>
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
// Your dark styles here
}
</style>
<!-- more stuff -->
</svg>
With this pattern, your light/dark favicon is only limited by your imagination. For example,
change the color of all lines
:
<svg>
<style>
path { fill: black; }
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
path { fill: white; }
}
</style>
<!-- more stuff -->
</svg>
Now is the time to actually write these styles. This is when the troubles begin.
SVGs are images, and the logo we are using to build our favicon was probably created with a tool like Adobe Illustrator or InkScape. Why not use the same tool again? That’s because apps like these haven’t really integrated CSS and media queries into their products. It’s not that they can’t handle them, but you have to forget the mouse-only experience they promise. You are going to use the keyboard and type code.
Which leads us to a second option: write the CSS by hand. After all, this is the way to go with front-end development. Why should it be different here? Unfortunately, SVG is often hard to read. Sure, this is an XML dialect, which is (almost) like HTML. But SVG images are cluttered with long
path
declarations and other markup we often don’t see in our day-to-day work. For example, the Raspberry Pi logo is more than 8KB of raw data. This make manual editing more tedious than it sounds.
That is a lot of code.
How to create an SVG favicon (in practice)
To understand how we can deal with an SVG favicon quickly and easily, we first need to define what we want to achieve.
The technique we covered above calls for creativity: replace a color, invert them all (which we’ll get to), change a shape… But the setup for a favicon is not the right time for this. A favicon should almost always be the website’s logo. Its appearance? Aesthetic? The message it conveys? All these questions have been answered already. Preparing the favicon should be fine-tuning the logo so it fits the small space allocated in browser tabs.
Often, the logo is perfect as-is and its favicon counterpart is a scaled down version of it. Sometimes, we need to add margin to make it square. What motivates a dark icon, then?
Contrast.
Many logos are designed for light backgrounds. When they don’t, another version exists solely for the purpose of darker backgrounds.
Notice that even the colors change slightly to account for the darker background.
Therefore, whether we prepare a favicon manually or with a tool, we automatically pick the light-compatible logo and start with that. After all, desktop tabs are traditionally white or light gray. The problem arises when going dark

data.title: Calendars, Contacts and Files in Stalwart
data.author: gpi
data.article_summary: Stalwart v0.12 发布，从邮件服务器演变为完整的通信与协作平台。新版本引入日历、联系人和文件存储的原生支持，采用 CalDAV、CardDAV 和 WebDAV 标准，无需第三方集成。支持群组日历、共享地址簿和团队文件夹，并通过 WebDAV ACL 管理权限。改进的垃圾邮件过滤系统可自动学习信任联系人，减少误报。性能方面，优化了多节点环境下的缓存和反序列化，提升速度和效率。集群协调新增对 Eclipse Zenoh、Apache Kafka、Redpanda、NATS 和 Redis 的支持。未来版本将引入 CalDAV 调度、JMAP 扩展等功能，进一步提升协作体验。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Stalwart邮件服务器的现状及其优缺点

不同观点：
• [rossy] 对Stalwart的FOSS（自由和开源软件）合规性表示担忧。他们指出，由于许可证问题，Arch包已被删除，主要问题包括Stalwart依赖专有代码构建，以及其Web管理界面包含专有代码。rossy认为这些问题本应很容易解决，但开发者多次推迟修复，令人失望，并考虑转向Maddy。

• [lb_] 对Stalwart由单个开发者主导的开发模式表示担忧。他认为，如果该开发者放弃项目或消失，可能会影响项目的持续性。

• [matja] 对Stalwart的集群功能和分布式数据库支持表示赞赏。他提到，这在实现高可用性（HA）方面比Dovecot的开源版本更具优势。

• [hatzz] 对Stalwart的主要开发者身份匿名表示疑虑，并指出难以找到有关Stalwart Labs公司的信息。他认为，开放性应包括开发者的透明度。

• [mjl-] 祝贺Stalwart的发布，并强调其集成的日历和地址簿功能，使得自托管PIM（个人信息管理）基础设施变得更加容易。

• [pluto_modadic] 对Stalwart重新聚焦于邮件相关功能而不是机器学习（ML）表示欢迎。

• [FlamingMoe] 支持Stalwart在邮件去中心化方向的努力。

• [throw_a_grenade] 提出为何选择Stalwart而非Nextcloud的问题，指出Nextcloud具有更大的生态系统和更多功能。

• [jazzyjackson] 提到Stalwart获得了NLnet的资助，暗示其具备一定的资金支持和可信度。

补充讨论：

44103071.article_content:
We’re excited to announce the release of
Stalwart v0.12
, a significant milestone that evolves Stalwart from a powerful mail server into a complete, integrated
communication and collaboration platform
. This release delivers one of the most anticipated features from our community:
native support for calendars, contacts, and file storage
—all built directly into the server, with no need for third-party integrations.
Calendars, Contacts & Files – All in One Place
​
With v0.12, you no longer need to integrate third-party groupware solutions or run parallel systems to support collaboration. Stalwart now includes first-class support for
CalDAV calendars
,
CardDAV contacts
, and
WebDAV-based file storage
. This means users can manage their events, address books, and documents through any standards-compliant client, seamlessly connected to the same backend that handles their email.
Shared resources such as
group calendars
,
shared address books
, and
team-accessible file folders
are also fully supported, providing a robust foundation for collaboration without the need for external software or services. And, to support flexible collaboration, Stalwart includes full support for the
WebDAV Access Control List (ACL) extension
, enabling detailed, per-user and per-group permission management.
Improved Spam Filtering
​
Another thoughtful addition in this release is the integration of the spam filter with users’ personal address books. Messages from known or trusted contacts are now far less likely to be incorrectly flagged as spam. And if a legitimate message does get misclassified, the system automatically trains the
Bayesian classifier
to treat future similar messages as legitimate, improving accuracy over time without additional user intervention.
Performance Enhancements
​
Under the hood, Stalwart v0.12 introduces several key performance optimizations designed especially for
large, multi-node environments
. One of the most impactful changes is the introduction of
incremental caching
: Stalwart now keeps account metadata in memory and only fetches updates when something changes in the database. This significantly reduces load and speeds up response times.
Another major enhancement is the use of
zero-copy deserialization
. This means Stalwart can read data directly from memory buffers without copying it into new structures, lowering CPU usage and improving throughput. Combined with optimizations that reduce the number of required
database queries
for common operations, these changes result in a leaner, faster backend that scales much more efficiently.
While these gains may not be noticeable in smaller setups,
larger clusters and high-volume deployments will see noticeable performance improvements
.
Smarter and Faster Clustering
​
We’ve also made big strides in
cluster coordination
. Previously, Stalwart relied on a UDP-based gossip protocol that performed well but didn’t scale ideally under heavy workloads. With v0.12, cluster behavior is now adaptable based on deployment size.
In
small deployments
, Stalwart uses
Eclipse Zenoh
, a lightweight and efficient peer-to-peer pub/sub protocol. For
larger infrastructures
, you can now choose from robust, scalable backends like
Apache Kafka
,
Redpanda
,
NATS
, or
Redis
for handling inter-node coordination, state synchronization, and workload distribution.
Looking Ahead: What’s Next?
​
With Stalwart v0.12, we're delivering more than just features—we're delivering
freedom from fragmented infrastructure
. No more patching together third-party services to get the basics of collaboration working. Now, everything—
email, calendars, contacts, files, and sharing
—lives in a single, efficient, and secure system.
While v0.12 is a major leap forward, we’re already preparing additional enhancements for the next point release. In
v0.12.1
, you can expect support for
CalDAV Scheduling (RFC 6638)
, enabling automatic meeting invitations and attendee responses. We’re also adding support for
event notification alerts via email
, so users are always aware of upcoming events, even if they're not logged into their calendars.
Additionally, in the coming months, we will be releasing support for the
JMAP for Calendars
,
JMAP for Contacts
, and
JMAP for File Storage
extensions. JMAP offers a modern, efficient, and JSON-based alternative to legacy protocols, making it faster and easier to develop responsive, real-time collaboration tools. These additions will further streamline the user experience and reduce bandwidth and processing overhead across client-server interactions.
Thank you to everyone who contributed feedback, suggestions, and encouragement. We can’t wait to hear what you build with this release—and we’re just getting started.

主要讨论点：用户对浏览器开发、功能更新及透明度的不同看法，特别是围绕Arc浏览器和Dia浏览器的讨论。

不同观点：
• [ko_pivot] 认为多空间（Space）功能是Arc浏览器的核心特色，但只有5.52%的日常活跃用户经常使用多空间，这让他感到惊讶。
• [WoodenChair] 对Dia浏览器从架构上优先考虑性能表示关注，特别是提到了停止使用TCA和SwiftUI，以保持Dia的轻量和快速响应，但对TCA是什么表示疑问。
• [rado] 喜欢垂直标签页功能，并希望该功能能在Safari甚至Chrome中出现。
• [tolerance] 对Arc浏览器开发者的态度持批评态度，认为其过于严肃且缺乏说服力。
• [twohaibei] 提到Arc浏览器在更新到manifest v3后，uBlock Origin插件无法使用，因此转向了Zen Browser。
• [nsonha] 没有使用Dia浏览器，但尝试过与Arc类似的Deta Surf浏览器，认为其AI集成更好，可以在同一个工作空间内引用标签页并与AI交流。
• [al_borland] 对Arc浏览器停止开发新功能并进入仅支持模式表示不满，认为缺乏透明度。他对文章中提到的“将软件维护得很好”持怀疑态度，认为浏览器需要持续进化，停留在安全更新和修复bug是不够的。他还指出，文章与实际行动的不一致性削弱了用户对开发者的信任。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于Arc浏览器停止开发新功能的决定以及透明度问题。一些用户认为开发者没有充分告知用户这一决定，导致用户感觉被“欺骗”。
• 用户对Dia浏览器的性能改进表示关注，但对Arc浏览器的经验使得他们对Dia持保留态度。
• 实验性浏览器在市场中的作用被认为是积极的，因为它们为新想法提供了试验平台，即便最终是由大公司采纳这些想法。

整体来看，用户对浏览器开发的持续性、功能进化以及开发者的透明度有较高期望，并对实验性浏览器的市场定位提出质疑。

data.title: The dystopia of '1984' is already here
data.author: belter
data.article_summary: 导演劳尔·佩克（Raoul Peck）的新纪录片《奥威尔：2+2=5》在戛纳电影节首映，该片基于乔治·奥威尔的反乌托邦小说《1984》，探讨当今社会中权力对真相的压制。影片通过奥威尔的文本、信件、历史照片以及电影改编片段，结合当代监控社会和真理崩塌的现实，揭示了双重思想和思想罪等概念的当代体现。由演员达米安·刘易斯（Damian Lewis）旁白，影片不仅回顾了奥威尔的生平，还聚焦他生命最后阶段在苏格兰小岛上带病完成《1984》的决心。佩克结合自身在海地和扎伊尔的经历，强调公民抵抗极权的重要性，并通过展示当代政治人物如特朗普、普京等，警示法西斯主义的回潮。影片呼吁观众反思个人在世界中的角色和责任。

44103074.article_content:
Álex Vicente
Cannes -
May 26, 2025 - 14:18
CEST
Share on Whatsapp
Share on Facebook
Share on Twitter
Share on Bluesky
Share on Linkedin
Copy link
“How many fingers am I holding up?” Winston Smith, the protagonist of
1984
, answers based on what his eyes tell him: there are four. Only the Party agent directing his re-education insists that there are five. By dint of electric shocks and various forms of torture, he begins to doubt his own perception, until at the end of the book he also perceives them: there are five, no doubt about it. This passage from
George Orwell’s great dystopian novel
, in which truth yields to the pressure of power, gives rise to the new documentary by Raoul Peck, 71,
Orwell: 2+2 = 5
, presented in the Cannes Première section of the film festival.
That scene is the symbol that Peck has chosen to describe a society in which Orwell’s theses are no longer predictions of the future, but pure reality. His vision — based on concepts such as Big Brother, newspeak,
doublethink
, or thoughtcrime — crosses a present marked by constant surveillance, social fear, and the crumbling of the notion of truth. Narrated by actor Damian Lewis, the documentary interweaves Orwell’s texts and letters with archival photographs, fragments of the film adaptations of
1984
(one made 1956, with Edmund O’Brien, and another in 1984, with John Hurt), scenes from other films, from
Oliver Twist
to
Notting Hill
(!), and images taken from television and social networks.
For Orwell, every project began with a sense of injustice that he wanted to confront. For Peck, it’s no different. From his first short film, about Cuban troubadour Carlos Puebla’s visit to Cold War Berlin, to his films about James Baldwin (
I Am Not Your Negro
) or South African photographer Ernest Cole, which premiered at Cannes last year, his cinema has followed a clear and consistent political line.
“I come from Haiti. From very early on, I saw the hypocrisies of those who proclaim themselves defenders of democracy. And I am a Black person: I was confronted with societies that had decided that I had no right to exist,” says Peck on a terrace overlooking the port of Cannes.
Director Raoul Peck (l) and Damian Lewis attend the photocall for 'Orwell : 2+2Cine, Francia
CLEMENS BILAN (EFE)
Peck, who grew up under several liberticidal regimes — that of François Duvalier in Haiti, and that of Mobutu Sese Seko during his exile in Zaire — and saw his father imprisoned as an opponent, understood from an early age the importance of speaking out when everyone else is silent.
“As Orwell said: hope, if it exists, has to be built. It does not appear on its own. In the history of humanity, that has never worked. You resist, you organize, you make it happen. Authoritarian regimes, because they lose a war or a revolution breaks out. It may take five years or 30, but the same thing always happens: the system collapses or the citizens resist.”
In that sense, his film seems like a call to action. “It’s not my role, but I want every citizen to ask themselves: what am I doing in this world? At least, those who have the privilege to ask themselves that question. A child born in
s
outhern Congo
, working in a mine so you can have an iPhone, doesn’t have that choice. But maybe you do...”
More than an ordinary biography, the documentary recalls Orwell in the last years of his life. Sick with tuberculosis and isolated on a remote farm on the Scottish island of Jura, he was determined to finish
1984
before it was too late. His literary testament was published in 1949, just six months before his death.
Peck takes as his starting point the famous Party slogan that structures the novel: “War is peace. Freedom is slavery. Ignorance is strength.” And he makes it the instrument for examining how fascism threatens to make a comeback around the world. Through his images parade Putin, Netanyahu, Milei and Meloni, although the great protagonist is Donald Trump, of course, and his systematic disregard for the truth.
George Orwell.
Orwell was well-acquainted with the mechanisms of oppression. He observed them in Europe, fighting with the
International Brigades in the Spanish Civil War
, but he also exercised them: he was born in colonial India, son of a British official of the Opium Department, and worked for five years as an officer of the Imperial Police in Burma. Both experiences awakened in the writer a visceral rejection of authoritarianism and a deep sense of guilt.
He once wrote that, without the Empire, Britain would be no more than “a cold and unimportant little island where we should all have to work very hard and live mainly on herrings and potatoes,” another observation that already bordered on prophecy.
“One of the things that brought me closest to Orwell when I started reading him was the feeling that he seemed like someone from the Third World, like me. He seemed close to me, someone who understood me, like a brother,” says Peck, politicized in the left-wing circles of 1970s B

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对一款非传统俄罗斯方块游戏的反馈和建议

不同观点：
• [hnlmorg] 认为游戏的随机方块生成可能存在问题，建议采用"single bag system"以减少特定方块长时间不出现的概率，从而降低游戏压力。
• [xnickb] 提到游戏可以帮助练习预判能力，但需要能看到接下来的几个方块。同时，他认为这款游戏比传统俄罗斯方块更放松。
• [lynx97] 分享了自己为盲文显示器用户开发的横向俄罗斯方块游戏，并提供了项目链接，展示了针对特殊用户群体的创新玩法。
• [irjustin] 提到自己尝试进行“全屏”挑战，虽然试图增加难度，但最终还是感受到压力，与游戏原本的放松设计初衷相悖。
• [lorikmor] 起初觉得游戏无聊，但后来喜欢上了这种不带来压力的玩法，认为这是一个有趣的概念。

补充讨论：
• [bramvanleur] 建议加入“撤销”功能，让方块可以从掉落位置重新调整，并希望游戏能根据玩家行为提供专业建议，帮助玩家提升技巧。
• [hansmayer] 开玩笑地建议加入MCP接口，让AI代替玩家进行游戏。
• [filt] 认为增加“幽灵方块”功能会有帮助，让玩家更直观地看到方块的落点。
• [metayrnc] 称赞游戏在移动设备上的操作体验非常好，没有常见的触摸屏操作问题。
• [aronhegedus] 提到自己在游戏开始时连续获得了多个“I”方块，以为游戏是某种特定方块变体。
• [darkwater] 指出在桌面版上使用键盘操作时，方块触底后无法再上移，导致操作失误并增加压力。
• [geon] 提到拖动操作存在问题，方块碰到墙壁时会卡住而不是滑动。
• [sali0] 建议将游戏开发成原生移动游戏，认为这会吸引更多玩家。
• [Obscurity4340] 建议逐步增加游戏的重力效果，使游戏从简单开始，随着时间推移逐渐增加难度，给玩家提供一个动态变化的挑战。

争议焦点：
- 游戏压力：部分玩家如[hnlmorg]和[xnickb]希望减少压力，而[irjustin]则通过自我挑战重新引入了压力，体现了玩家对游戏难度的不同需求。

data.title: Clojure MCP
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: Clojure MCP 是一个处于早期开发阶段的 Alpha 软件，旨在通过 AI 辅助实现 Clojure 项目的 REPL 驱动开发。它提供一个 MCP 服务器，连接 AI 模型与 Clojure nREPL，并集成专用 Clojure 编辑工具，提升开发效率。主要功能包括 Clojure REPL 连接、Clojure 感知编辑（使用 clj-kondo、parinfer 等工具）、以及为 Clojure 开发优化的工具集。该项目强调即时反馈、增量开发、人工监督和函数式编程。安装需配置 Clojure、Java、Claude Desktop 等环境，并将 MCP 服务器与 nREPL 连接。项目可在本地运行，但目前需共享文件系统。用户可通过配置文件接入 Claude Desktop 实现 AI 辅助开发。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）助手在编程开发中的应用，特别是与状态性REPL（交互式编程环境）的结合及其在Clojure等语言中的效果和价值。

不同观点：
• **brucehauman**：认为将LLM助手与状态性REPL结合使用能极大提升开发效率。LLM可以自动生成代码、测试用例并即时执行，甚至能设置测试框架，自动进行代码测试和验证。这种体验非常棒，是一种极其有效的工作流。

• **rads**：对LLM工具持谨慎态度，认为Clojure社区重视代码的简洁性和深入理解，过度依赖LLM工具可能违背这些原则。虽然LLM在搜索和设计反馈方面有价值，但将代码上下文输入LLM可能过于耗时，因此更多地用于通用设计问题，而非具体代码问题。

• **danw1979**：支持使用LLM与IDE集成的方法，即使自己不是Clojure用户，也通过设置Jetbrains MCP服务器和Claude Desktop获得了良好的体验。建议通过系统提示让LLM获取项目上下文以提高反馈质量。

• **tosh**：认为REPL驱动的开发与当前的代理概念天然契合，并提到brucehauman之前开发的Figwheel工具（用于ClojureScript的热重载），暗示这种结合有历史渊源和技术基础。

• **makizar**和**cldwalker**：分享了一个演示视频，展示了REPL助手的实际应用，并对该方法在较大代码库中的效果表示好奇和关注。

• **mark_l_watson**：认为该工具填补了一个有用的 niche，但自己主要使用Gemini、OpenAI和本地模型，因此不适用。顺便提到Google Jules对Clojure开发有帮助，并设置提醒关注未来是否支持其他平台。

• **ihodes**：提出一种设想，希望有一个MCP可以连接到正在运行的前端页面（如Chrome标签），让代理既能视觉检查又能与页面交互，还能查看网络和控制台标签，认为这将非常有用。

• **fjalahdbtnt**：质疑为何要为聊天机器人使用桌面应用，认为API应该是首选。对使用Claude Desktop以避免API费用表示不解，认为这种做法不合理。

补充讨论：
- 对LLM在具体编程工作流中的实际效果存在不同看法，部分人（如brucehauman）非常看好其提升开发效率的能力，而其他人（如rads）则持怀疑态度，认为其对长期维护和代码理解可能有负面影响。
- 关于LLM工具的收费与使用便捷性存在争议，部分用户（如danw1979）认为Claude Desktop可以避免API费用并提高体验，但fjalahdbtnt则质疑这种做法的经济性。
- 对LLM工具在较大代码库中的适用性存在疑问，尤其是其在处理复杂项目时的表现如何，仍需进一步验证。

Clojure MCP - REPL-Driven Development with AI Assistance
⚠️
Alpha Software - Work in Progress
This project is in early development and rapidly evolving. While I've found it invaluable for working with Clojure projects and it has significantly improved my development workflow, expect breaking changes, rough edges, and incomplete documentation.
🤝 Help Wanted!
If you find this useful, please consider contributing:
Report bugs and issues you encounter
Suggest improvements or new features
Submit pull requests for fixes or enhancements
Share your configuration patterns and workflows
Help improve documentation and examples
Your feedback and contributions will help make this tool better for the entire Clojure community!
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Clojure that provides a
complete set of tools to aid in the development of Clojure projects.
🚀 Overview
This project implements an MCP server that connects AI models to a
Clojure nREPL, and Specialized Clojure editing tools enabling a unique
Clojure develop experience.
Clojure MCP provides a superset of the tools that Claude Code uses,
so you can use it to work on Clojure
without any other tools
.  I
highly recommend using it with Claude Desktop to start.  It's
prettier and there are
no api charges!
Claude Desktop also let's you
have quick access to
your own prompts
and other resources provided
by the clojure-mcp server. Having a stack of your own prompts
available in a UI menu is pretty nice.
Main Features
Clojure REPL Connection
Clojure Aware editing
- Using clj-kondo, parinfer, cljfmt, and clj-rewrite
Optimized set of tools for Clojure Development
superset of Claude Code
Emacs edit highlighting
- alpha
Why REPL-Driven Development with AI?
This approach enables:
Immediate feedback
- Validate code by running it in a stateful REPL, not just statically analyzing it
Incremental development
- Build solutions in small, verified steps
Human oversight
- Keep the programmer in the loop for guidance
Functional approach
- Encourage pure functions that are easier to understand and test
📋 Installation
Prerequisites
Clojure
(1.11 or later)
Java
(JDK 11 or later)
Claude Desktop
(for the best experience)
Setting up the project
Step 1: Get the Clojure MCP Server
Clone this repository to your development machine
git clone https://github.com/bhauman/clojure-mcp.git
or use it as git dep in your
deps.edn
{
:deps
{bhauman/clojure-mcp {
:git/url
"
https://github.com/bhauman/clojure-mcp.git
"
:git/sha
"
latest-main-branch-sha
"
}}
Step 2: Configure Your Target Project
In the Clojure project where you want AI assistance, add MCP server configuration to your
deps.edn
:
{
:aliases
{
;
; nREPL server for AI to connect to
:nrepl
{
:extra-paths
[
"
test
"
]
:extra-deps
{nrepl/nrepl {
:mvn/version
"
1.3.1
"
}
ch.qos.logback/logback-classic {
:mvn/version
"
1.4.14
"
}}
:jvm-opts
[
"
-Djdk.attach.allowAttachSelf
"
]
:main-opts
[
"
-m
"
"
nrepl.cmdline
"
"
--port
"
"
7888
"
]}
;
; MCP server configuration (for reference)
:mcp
{
:extra-deps
{org.slf4j/slf4j-nop {
:mvn/version
"
2.0.16
"
}
clojure-mcp/clojure-mcp {
:local/root
"
/path/to/clojure-mcp
"
}}
:exec-fn
clojure-mcp.main/start-mcp-server
:exec-args
{
:port
7888
}}}}
Important
: Replace
/path/to/clojure-mcp
with the actual path to your cloned repository.
IMPORTANT NOTE: the mcp server can run in any directory and DOES NOT
have to run in your project.  The mcp server looks to the nREPL
connection for context.  The root directory of the project that is
running the nREPL server becomes the root directory of all the mcp
tool invocations. Currently the nREPL must run on the same machine
as the MCP server as there is an assumption of a shared file system
between the nREPL server and the MCP server.
Step 3: Configure Claude Desktop
Edit your Claude Desktop configuration file:

cd /path/to/your/clojure/project && PATH=/your/bin-or-nix/path:$PATH && clojure -X:mcp :port 7888
"

}

data.article_summary: 文章披露了GitHub MCP服务器的一个严重漏洞，该漏洞允许攻击者通过恶意GitHub Issue劫持用户代理，窃取私有代码库的数据。这一漏洞由Invariant的安全分析工具发现，属于首次发现的“有毒代理流”（Toxic Agent Flows）类型。攻击者可在公共代码库中创建恶意问题，当用户查询代理时触发数据泄露，将私有信息暴露在公开的代码库中。文章详细描述了攻击步骤、演示了具体案例，并提出了检测和缓解此类攻击的方法。这一漏洞提醒业界在部署编码代理和集成开发环境时需提高安全意识。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕LLM（如Claude）在使用GitHub访问令牌时的潜在安全问题和漏洞的讨论

不同观点：
• **losvedir**：认为用户在给LLM提供凭证时应该意识到该凭证的权限范围。如果使用细粒度的访问令牌，限制其仅能访问必要的资源，这种攻击不会成功。攻击的成功依赖于LLM拥有全局访问权限，这是危险的。
• **mirzap**：不认为这是一种“ exploit（漏洞利用）”。如果给代理提供了一个访问私有仓库的令牌，那么它就可以访问该仓库。问题的关键在于权限设置，而不是工具本身的漏洞。
• **kiitos**：认为有关漏洞的声明被夸大了。问题的发生需要多个条件同时满足，包括用户设置不当等。这并不完全是系统漏洞，更多是用户配置不当导致。
• **adeon**：从安全角度出发，认为如果LLM处理来自不可信来源的文本，该来源可能引导LLM生成任意文本并调用工具，因此存在风险。同时，指出需要外部安全产品来加强AI系统的安全性，表明AI公司在安全设计上不足。
• **godelski**：认为问题核心在于用户将敏感信息交给了不可信的第三方。这更像是一个用户错误，而非系统漏洞。同时质疑将未成熟的AI技术用于对安全有高要求的场景是否合适。
• **ttoinou**：建议用户可以精细控制LLM对自身信息的访问权限，并希望通过软件硬性限制而不是依赖LLM的模糊描述来保障安全。
• **drkrab**：指出当用户给第三方访问GitHub仓库时，也必须信任该第三方遵循所有安全策略，这实际上很难完全保证。
• **TOMDM**：认为问题类似于将私人信息暴露给公众然后惊讶于信息泄露。如果不希望LLM访问某些私人信息，就不应给予其访问权限。
• **ed**：不认为这是攻击，因为Claude只是按照要求执行任务。建议GitHub考虑引入人工审核机制以防止意外泄露。

补充讨论：
• **mcintyre1994**：对LLM提到的“排除minesweeper”感到好奇，并怀疑是否存在一个私有仓库与此相关。
• **lbeurerkellner**：分享了一个具体的恶意issue链接，展示LLM如何被引导完成利用。
• **pawanjswal**：对一个简单的GitHub issue能导致私有仓库数据泄露表示惊讶。
• **kapitanjakc**：分享了GitHub Copilot之前也存在读取私有仓库的经历，表明类似问题早已存在。

争议焦点：
• 该问题是否应被视为系统漏洞还是用户配置错误。
• LLM处理不可信输入时的潜在风险以及是否需要外部安全产品来增强安全性。
• 是否应在安全敏感场景中使用尚未成熟的AI技术。

44097390.article_content:
2025-05-26
GitHub MCP Exploited: Accessing private repositories via MCP
We showcase a critical vulnerability with the official GitHub MCP server, allowing attackers to access private repository data. The vulnerability is among the first discovered by Invariant's security analyzer for detecting toxic agent flows.
Invariant has discovered a critical vulnerability affecting the widely-used
GitHub MCP integration
(14k stars on GitHub). The vulnerability allows an attacker to hijack a user's agent via a malicious GitHub Issue, and coerce it into leaking data from private repositories.
The issue is among the first, discovered by Invariant's automated security scanners for detecting so-called
Toxic Agent Flows
. In such a scenario, an agent is manipulated into performing unintended actions, such as leaking data or executing malicious code. For more information,
see below
.
It is highly relevant to raise awareness about this issue at this time, as the industry is racing to deploy coding agents and IDEs widely, potentially exposing users to similar attacks on critical software development tools.
Contents
Attack Setup
Attack Demonstration
Detecting Toxic Agent Flows
Mitigations
Conclusion
Attack Setup
In this attack setup, the user is using an MCP client like Claude Desktop with the
Github MCP server
connected to their account.
We assume the user has created two repositories:
<user>/public-repo
: A publicly accessible repository, allowing everyone on GitHub to create issues and bug reports.
<user>/private-repo
: A private repository, e.g. with proprietary code or private company data.
By standard GitHub rules, an attacker can now create a malicious issue on the public repository, containing a prompt injection waiting for the agent to interact.
The actual attack triggers as soon as the user and owner of the GitHub account queries their agent with a benign request, such as
Have a look at the open issues in
<user>/public-repo
, which will lead to the agent fetching the issues from the public repository and getting injected.
See below for an illustration of the ensuing flow.
As shown here, as soon as the agent encounters the malicious GitHub issue, it can be coerced into pulling private repository data into context, and leaking it in an autonomously-created PR in the public repository, freely accessible to the attacker or anyone else.
Toxic Flows
We call this use of indirect prompt injection to trigger a malicious tool use sequence, a
toxic agent flow
. We have found this vulnerability by applying Invariant's security analyzer to GitHub MCP, allowing us to automate the process of discovering the flow in the wild.
Attack Demonstration
To illustrate more concretely, we implement this attack practically using a set of demo repositories:
ukend0464/pacman
: A public repository with a simple implementation of a Pacman game (
available here
)
Multiple private repositories containing personal projects and sensitive information about the user.
'About The Author' injection
We now place a
malicious issue
in the public repository, which is accessible to the attacker. The issue contains a payload that will be executed by the agent as soon as it queries the public repository's list of issues.
User Interaction
To trigger the attack, the user merely prompts
Claude 4 Opus
with the following request:
Claude then uses the GitHub MCP integration to follow the instructions. Throughout this process, Claude Desktop by default requires the user to confirm individual tool calls. However, many users already opt for an “Always Allow” confirmation policy when using agents, and stop monitoring individual actions.
Attack Rollout
The agent now goes through the list of issues until it finds the attack payload. It willingly pulls private repository data into context, and leaks it into a
pull request
of the
pacman
repo, which is freely accessible to the attacker since it is public.
The pull request contains the following new information:
We thus successfully exfiltrated several pieces of
private information
about our user
ukend0464
: information about their private repositories, such as
Jupiter Star
, their plan to relocate to South America, and even their salary.
Below, we include a screenshot of the full chat with the agent, showing its reasoning and tool use sequence in action.
Click to see full chat with the agent.
Detecting Toxic Agent Flows
Unlike previously-discovered
tool poisoning attacks
with MCP, this vulnerability does not require the MCP tools themselves to be compromised. Instead, the issue emerges even with fully trusted tools, as agents can be exposed to untrusted information when connected to external platforms like GitHub.
Understanding, analyzing, and mitigating such issues in agentic systems is a highly complex undertaking that's difficult to perform manually and at scale. To address this challenge, Invariant has developed
automated methods for detecting toxic agent flows
, enabling organizations to identify and model potential threat

data.title: Rock, paper, scissors showdown
data.author: fidotron
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕“石头剪刀布策略竞赛”的参与经历和算法分析

不同观点：
• [srean] 认为自己的策略（基于压缩算法和历史预测）虽然没有赢得比赛，但表现超出预期。他指出，若比赛回合更多，Lempel-Ziv压缩算法可能会更有效。他还提到更复杂的算法（如基于transformer的模型）未必更优，因为需要从极少数据中快速学习非固定策略。
• [fidotron] 介绍了比赛的技术细节，包括自定义WebGL2渲染器和使用FoundationDB的排行榜。他确认使用了5链集成的马尔科夫链预测模型，并指出这种模型比作弊方式更具趣味性。
• [avodonosov] 分享了自己的比赛数据，表示不清楚马尔科夫链如何学习及如何利用其弱点。他建议增加统计总积分功能，并抱怨每回合的摄像头抖动效果让他感到烦躁。
• [sugarkjube] 提到自己通过猜测电脑的策略并改变自己的出招来尝试对抗学习算法，但难以长时间坚持这种玩法。
• [ponco] 提到同事的午餐室 tricks，可能是行为心理学和模式识别的结合，引发了对人类策略与机器学习结合的思考。
• [croemer] 质疑是否真的使用了马尔科夫链，认为标题可能是为了吸引注意力而编造的。
• [gnarlouse] 和 [bArray] 分享了自己的比赛成绩，并对能够在比赛中持续多轮表示满意。
• [rkagerer] 对比赛体验持负面态度，认为浪费了时间。
• [sweeter] 分享了自己的高分和尝试通过条件反射来对抗算法的策略。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：[croemer] 对是否真正使用马尔科夫链提出质疑，而 [fidotron] 的回应确认了其使用。
• 技术探讨：包括对马尔科夫链的具体实现方式、比赛中的技术细节（如WebGL2渲染器和FoundationDB的使用）。
• 游戏体验：一些玩家（如 [avodonosov]）对摄像头抖动效果不满，而 [BrenBarn] 则对游戏的图形和音乐感到有趣。
• 策略讨论：玩家们分享了不同的策略，包括基于历史数据的预测、改变自己的出招模式以对抗算法等。

总体来看，讨论围绕技术实现、游戏策略和玩家体验展开，展示了不同背景的玩家对石头剪刀布策略竞赛的多角度看法。

data.title: High strength bio-concrete for the production of building components
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种基于微生物诱导碳酸钙沉淀（MICP）的高强度生物混凝土，作为传统波特兰水泥混凝土的潜在替代品。生物混凝土在生物矿化过程中不产生二氧化碳排放，且能以碳酸盐形式固碳，具有CO2中和潜力。然而，实现与传统混凝土相当的抗压强度和足够的组件深度一直是挑战。研究通过使用尿素酶活性碳酸钙粉末（UACP）、优化骨料密实度、以及自动停止流压注射方法，测试了多种水泥化参数，最终达到52.5 MPa的抗压强度和140 mm的 cementation深度，这在以往研究中未见报道。研究结果显示，均匀密实和足够的骨料密实度是获得高质量水泥化的关键，这为生物混凝土用于预制承重建筑组件开辟了新可能性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：生物混凝土生产中的生态挑战及其潜在问题

不同观点：
• 正面观点：评论者认为生物混凝土技术听起来非常有趣且具有前景，表明了对该技术潜在优势的认可。
• 生态挑战观点：评论者指出生物混凝土生产过程中存在一些明显的生态挑战，包括合成尿素的高能量需求和废水径流问题，这显示了对环境影响的关注。
• 材料挑战观点：评论者提到了钙质生物混凝土对钢筋的腐蚀问题，由于氯化钙的使用，钢筋可能会受到腐蚀，因此需要使用耐腐蚀的增强材料，暗示了材料选择上的技术难题。

补充讨论：
• 技术可行性：评论中隐含了对生物混凝土技术可行性的讨论，特别是在解决材料腐蚀和能量需求方面的技术难题后，该技术才能更具应用前景。
• 争议焦点：生物混凝土的环境效益和技术挑战之间的权衡是争议的焦点，即尽管该技术具有前景，但其生产过程中产生的生态问题需要有效的解决方案。

High strength bio-concrete for the production of building components
Download PDF
Download PDF
Subjects
Biomaterials
Civil engineering
Structural materials
Abstract
The production of bio-concrete is based on the process of microbially-induced calcium carbonate precipitation (MICP), in which calcium carbonate (CaCO
3
) is formed as a binder. Bio-concrete is a potentially CO
2
-neutral alternative to conventional Portland-cement-based concrete, since no process-related carbon dioxide emissions are generated during biomineralization. Furthermore, CO
2
is bound in the form of carbonate. However, achieving compressive strength values comparable to conventional concrete, in combination with sufficient component depth, has been a significant challenge in the MICP research. In the present study, a combination of methods was implemented, including the use of urease-active calcium carbonate powder (UACP) instead of free bacterial cells, optimization of aggregate packing density, and the implementation of an automated stop-flow pressure injection method. A variety of cementation parameters were tested to determine the optimal conditions for the production of homogeneously cemented high strength bio-concrete. Additionally, reproducibility and optimization studies have been conducted with selected parameter combinations. It was found that achieving homogeneous compaction with sufficient aggregate packing density played a crucial role in obtaining consistent and high-quality cementation results. A combination of a very high compressive strength of 52.5 MPa and a cementation depth of 140 mm has been reached, which has not been reported in previous publications. These findings might unveil new possibilities for bio-concrete to be used in the production of prefabricated load-bearing building components, where it could partially replace traditional concrete.

Introduction
Portland-cement-based concrete is a crucial building material in modern construction. According to the International Energy Agency (IEA) the carbon dioxide emissions from cement production have not changed after an increase in 2018 and remained high in 2022 (ca. 0.6 t CO
2
per tonne of cement
1
). Consequently, the production of cement, contributes to around 7 to 8% of the global CO
2
emissions
2
,
3
. Even though energy-related emissions can be reduced by shifting to renewable energy sources, process emissions from the calcination of limestone cannot be eliminated entirely. Clinker substitution is often used to tackle the problem of process emissions, but this still falls within the traditional clinker-based cement paradigm.
Bio-concrete represents a different approach, in which aggregates are consolidated by calcium carbonate crystals produced through microbially-induced calcium carbonate precipitation (MICP). The biomineralization through MICP is CO

data.author: barthelomew
data.article_summary: 这篇文章探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）在自动化推理任务中的可靠性问题，重点研究了LLMs生成形式化规格时的失败模式和不确定性。通过对五种前沿LLMs的系统评估，研究发现基于Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) 的自动形式化在不同领域对准确性有显著影响（逻辑任务提高34.8%，事实任务下降44.5%）。已知的不确定性量化（UQ）技术无法有效识别这些错误。为此，文章引入了一种概率上下文无关文法（PCFG）框架，提出了新的不确定性分类法，并根据任务依赖的信号（如语法熵）进行选择性验证，显著减少错误率（14-100%），从而使LLM驱动的形式化成为可靠的工程实践。

View a PDF of the paper titled Grammars of Formal Uncertainty: When to Trust LLMs in Automated Reasoning Tasks, by Debargha Ganguly and 9 other authors
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) show remarkable promise for democratizing automated reasoning by generating formal specifications. However, a fundamental tension exists: LLMs are probabilistic, while formal verification demands deterministic guarantees. This paper addresses this epistemological gap by comprehensively investigating failure modes and uncertainty quantification (UQ) in LLM-generated formal artifacts. Our systematic evaluation of five frontier LLMs reveals Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) based autoformalization's domain-specific impact on accuracy (from +34.8% on logical tasks to -44.5% on factual ones), with known UQ techniques like the entropy of token probabilities failing to identify these errors. We introduce a probabilistic context-free grammar (PCFG) framework to model LLM outputs, yielding a refined uncertainty taxonomy. We find uncertainty signals are task-dependent (e.g., grammar entropy for logic, AUROC>0.93). Finally, a lightweight fusion of these signals enables selective verification, drastically reducing errors (14-100%) with minimal abstention, transforming LLM-driven formalization into a reliable engineering discipline.

data.title: Demonstrating end-to-end scientific discovery with Robin: a multi-agent system
data.author: eamag
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了多代理系统Robin在科学研究中的首个自动化发现。由FutureHouse团队开发，Robin整合了Crow、Falcon和Finch等专用AI代理，自动化科学发现的各个关键步骤。Robin通过文献综述、假设生成、实验设计和数据分析，发现了治疗干性年龄相关性黄斑变性（dAMD）的新候选药物——ripasudil。这一发现过程完全由AI驱动，人类研究员仅执行实际实验。Robin在短短2.5个月内完成了从概念化到论文提交的全过程，展示了AI在加速科学发现中的潜力。该系统将于5月27日作为开源发布，旨在激励更多自动化发现系统的开发和应用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[关于ripasudil作为新型年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）治疗手段的发现，以及该发现过程中自动化科学研究的角色]

不同观点：
• [kgeist的观点] 认为ripasudil是通过基于第一轮药物候选测试数据提出的第二轮药物候选测试中发现的，并且已经被用于眼科。kgeist引用了2020年发表的文章，指出ripasudil能够缓解视网膜色素上皮（RPE）细胞的炎症，而这种炎症与AMD的发生和发展相关。

• [throw310822的观点] 提出疑问，是否这是首次完全自动化进行的科学研究或发现。这暗示了对该发现过程中自动化程度的关注，以及对该发现是否具有历史性意义的质疑。

补充讨论：
• [kgeist引用的研究] 提供了具体的科学依据，表明ripasudil在缓解RPE细胞炎症方面的效果，并指出这种效果对AMD的潜在治疗意义。

• [throw310822的提问] 提示了对科学发现过程中自动化技术应用程度的关注，可能涉及对人工智能或自动化系统在科学研究中角色的更广泛讨论。

争议焦点：
• 是否可以将ripasudil的发现过程视为完全自动化的科学发现，这可能需要进一步明确在该研究中自动化系统的具体作用和贡献程度。

Announcements

Today, we announce the first discovery made by Robin, our multi-agent system for automating scientific research.Â
Read the preprint here:
https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13400
Robin code, data and full agent trajectories will be released Tuesday 5/27
FutureHouse's mission is to automate scientific discovery. Until now,
we've released specialized AI agents to automate individual aspects of the discovery process
:
Crow, Falcon, and Owl
for literature search and synthesis;
Phoenix
for chemical synthesis design; and
Finch
for complex data analysis.
Today, we are excited to announce a significant breakthrough: by integrating these agents into a unified system named
Robin
, we've been able to automate the key intellectual steps of the entire scientific process and achieve our first AI-generated discovery. Robin is a workflow that orchestrates Crow
,
Falcon
,
and Finch
to propose and pre-clinically validate novel treatments for any human disease. We applied Robin to identify ripasudil, a Rho-kinase (ROCK) inhibitor clinically used to treat glaucoma, as a novel therapeutic candidate for dry age-related macular degeneration (dAMD), a leading cause of irreversible blindness worldwide.Â Â
How Robin Made Its First Discovery
Robin made this discovery through an iterative cycle of hypothesis generation, experimental design, and data analysis:
Initial Hypothesis:
Robin used Crow to conduct a broad literature review, and hypothesized that enhancing retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) phagocytosis could provide therapeutic benefit for dAMD. Robin then used Falcon to evaluate a set of candidate molecules that might be able to do this, and we tested ten of them in the lab. Using Finch, Robin then analyzed the data from these experiments to find that the ROCK inhibitor Y-27632 augmented RPE phagocytosis in cell culture.Â
Mechanism Investigation:
Robin next proposed an RNA-sequencing experiment to determine if Y-27632 was inducing gene expression changes that might explain the increased phagocytosis of RPE cells. We did the experiment, and Finch analyzed the data and identified that Y-27632 upregulated
ABCA1
, a critical lipid efflux pump in RPE cells.
Discovery of ripasudil as a novel dAMD treatment:
Using the data from the first round of drug candidate testing, Robin proposed a second set of drug candidates. We tested them in the same experiment to find there was a new top hit: ripasudil, a drug already used in the eye.Â
All hypotheses, experiment choices, data analyses, and main text figures in the manuscript describing this work were generated by Robin autonomously. Human researchers executed the physical experiments, but the intellectual framework was entirely AI-driven.
A New Paradigm for Scientific Research
What's particularly notable is how quickly we were able to build Robin and use it to make this discovery. The entire processâfrom conceptualizing Robin to paper submissionâwas completed in just 2.5 months by a small team of researchers. Our goal was to determine whether it was possible to generate and validate a novel therapeutic idea using an interpretable workflow of only three agents. We think weâve achieved that.
By automating hypothesis generation, experimental planning, and data analysis in an integrated system, Robin represents a powerful new paradigm for AI-driven scientific discovery. Although we first applied Robin to therapeutics, our agents are general-purpose and can be used for a wide variety of discoveries across diverse fieldsâfrom materials science to climate technology. We're releasing Robin as open-source on Tuesday, May 27th, and hope that our approach of orchestrating our agents in simple workflows will inspire others to build their own systems for automated discovery.

data.author: XzetaU8
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了Windows平台上预构建的Mesa3D驱动程序项目（mesa-dist-win），包括下载、已知问题、安装使用方法和常见错误的解决方案。项目获得了赞助，提供了一台用于构建的VPS服务器。文章列出了多个已知问题，如某些DLL文件缺失错误，并提供了相应的修复方法，如重新部署应用或运行修复脚本。此外，还说明了Mesa版本更新带来的变化和环境变量配置问题，帮助用户解决驱动程序使用中的常见问题。64位二进制文件曾需要AVX支持的问题已修复，Mesa 22.0及更新版本不再有此问题。

不同观点：
• **bno1的观点**：OpenGL在某些现代应用中仍然存在使用问题，例如在Windows 11的QEMU虚拟机中运行rekordbox时遇到的启动失败问题。bno1认为这是由于开发者未在无GPU加速的系统上充分测试应用所致。
  
• **sylware的观点**：OpenGL已经过时，Linux环境下仅在一些遗留的32位应用（如Steam客户端）中还需要使用。sylware指出，转向Wayland和Vulkan是更现代的选择，但遗留应用的兼容性处理工作量巨大。sylware还提到，尽管有Xwayland作为过渡方案，但维护和调试这个复杂的栈非常困难。sylware自己仍在使用Xorg，但正在编写自己的Wayland合成器以逐渐脱离X11。

• **nicman23的观点**：提出关于Lavapipe（软件渲染）和Virgl（利用主机GPU的虚拟化技术）在处理OpenGL应用时的适用性问题，询问是否仅Lavapipe就足够，还是需要Virgl来利用主机GPU。

补充讨论：
• **技术实现的复杂性**：sylware特别提到了从X11转向Wayland过程中技术栈的复杂性，尤其是Xwayland和GLX/GL栈的维护和调试难度，反映出开发者在处理遗留系统和现代系统过渡时的实际困难。

• **具体技术方案的讨论**：nicman23的问题引发了对具体技术方案的讨论，即Lavapipe和Virgl在处理OpenGL应用上的不同作用和适用场景，表明社区对实际解决方案的关注。

争议焦点：
• OpenGL作为遗留技术是否应继续支持，以及如何在现代系统（如Wayland和Vulkan）中高效兼容和处理遗留OpenGL应用，是讨论的主要争议点。sylware强调了过渡的复杂性和工作量，而nicman23则关注具体的实现方案。

data.title: Bank transactions cleared by FTP-ing files
data.author: jv22222
data.article_summary: 文章主要指出，某些与隐私相关的浏览器扩展程序可能会导致在x.com（即推特）上出现问题。建议用户禁用这些扩展程序，然后重试访问网站，以解决可能出现的故障。文章提醒用户不必担心，只需按照提示操作即可。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：金融和技术行业中数据传输和协作方式的现状及其问题

不同观点：
• [drfunk] 对讨论主题感到情绪激动，暗示对现状的强烈反应。
• [kotaKat] 指出在医疗保健行业中也存在类似的现象，通过VPN和FTP传输文件，幸运的话可能会使用SFTP连接来传输HL7文件。
• [bobek] 描述了一家金融科技公司通过CSV导出、FTP或电子邮件传输、Excel验证，然后再导入到中心数据库的方式，导致了数据丢失问题。
• [johngladtj] 支持bobek的观点，表示在基金管理的后台操作中，文件传输故障是日常工作中的常见问题。
• [foobarkey] 提到在银行业中，(S)FTP集成是许多操作的基础，尤其是与合作伙伴银行的SWIFT事务。
• [_trampeltier] 简单表示当前系统虽然有问题但仍然能工作，暗示对变革的需求不强烈。
• [mike_hearn] 详细分析了金融行业难以变革的原因，包括其去中心化特性、缺乏主导实体来推动标准化、以及企业和技术部门之间的不信任。他还提到区块链曾被视为解决方案，但实际效果不如预期。

补充讨论：
• [Fizzadar] 提供了一个2014年的系列文章链接，讨论了金融系统的缓慢和脆弱性，并指出没有升级到实时系统。
• [UltraSane] 提到曾在一家公司工作，需要验证从大银行通过FTP发送的用PGP密钥签名的文件，显示出在安全措施上的一些实践。

争议焦点：
• 当前金融和技术行业使用的传统传输方式（如FTP）是否需要变革以及如何有效地进行变革。
• 金融行业在技术标准化和现代化方面的挑战，包括去中心化结构带来的复杂性以及对区块链技术的不成功尝试。

整体来看，讨论反映了金融和技术行业在数据传输和协作方面的现实问题，以及变革过程中面临的多重障碍和考虑。

data.title: Gamers and reviewers should learn from the mess with the Nvidia RTX 5060
data.author: speckx
data.article_summary: Nvidia面临信任危机，因其在RTX 5060显卡评测过程中被指操控和限制评测。为避免重蹈2022年4060显卡被 harsh 评价的覆辙，Nvidia reportedly 采取了多种手段，包括选择在大多数评测者参加Computex大会时发布产品，延迟提供驱动程序，以及只允许部分评测者在限定条件下提前测试。这些评测者只能测试五款特定游戏，且对比的也是较弱的旧型号显卡。更有甚者，Nvidia还被指威胁某些评测者，若不按其要求进行“虚假帧数”对比，将取消未来合作。此举引发广泛批评，特别是GamersNexus，他们公开反抗Nvidia的压力并威胁公布电话录音。这一事件暴露了Nvidia与评测者之间信任的破裂，也提醒业界和消费者警惕这种操控行为。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Nvidia在游戏业务和AI业务之间的战略重心转移，以及对游戏社区和媒体的关注度变化。

不同观点：
• **brudgers**认为Nvidia将重心从游戏业务转移到AI业务是理性的决策。他指出，Nvidia从AI业务中获得的利润已经远超游戏业务，因此公司对游戏社区（B2C）的需求和 drama 不感兴趣。他还质疑新显卡的实际性能提升，认为只是制造工艺的改进，而不是为满足游戏玩家需求而设计的突破性产品。此外，他提出一个疑问：对新显卡不满的到底是普通消费者，还是那些获得免费GPU做评测的人？

• **altairprime**则没有直接讨论Nvidia的战略转移，而是关注文章的获取问题。他对文章的部分内容被付费墙挡住表示不满，并询问是否有其他方式（如镜像链接）来访问完整内容。

补充讨论：
• **争议的焦点**在于Nvidia是否应该继续重视游戏社区的需求，还是全力转向AI等高利润领域。**brudgers**明确表示Nvidia不需要再特别关注游戏市场，而潜在的反对方（如普通游戏玩家）可能认为公司忽视了他们的需求。
• **altairprime**的评论引出了一个实际阅读体验的问题，即付费墙对获取信息的阻碍，这虽然不是核心讨论点，但影响了讨论的参与度。

整体来看，讨论围绕Nvidia在不同业务领域的战略选择以及信息获取的实际问题展开。

Nvidia’s RTX 5060 review debacle should be a wake-up call for gamers and reviewers
Seems Nvidia didn’t want its most popular GPU raked over the coals this year — and risked its credibility to prevent it.
Seems Nvidia didn’t want its most popular GPU raked over the coals this year — and risked its credibility to prevent it.
by
Sean Hollister
May 22, 2025, 5:27 PM UTC
Link
Facebook
Threads
If you buy something from a Verge link, Vox Media may earn a commission.
See our ethics statement.
Image: Nvidia
Sean Hollister
is a senior editor and founding member of The Verge who covers gadgets, games, and toys. He spent 15 years editing the likes of CNET, Gizmodo, and Engadget.
Nvidia has gone too far.
This week, the company reportedly attempted to delay, derail, and manipulate reviews of its $299 GeForce RTX 5060 graphics card, which would normally be its bestselling GPU of the generation. Nvidia has repeatedly and publicly said the budget 60-series cards are its most popular, and this year it reportedly tried to ensure it by withholding access and pressuring reviewers to paint them in the best light possible.
Nvidia might have wanted to prevent a repeat of 2022, when it launched this card’s predecessor.
Those reviews were
harsh
. The 4060 was called a “slap in the face to gamers” and a “wet fart of a GPU.” I had guessed the 5060 was headed for the same fate after seeing
how reviewers handled the 5080
, which similarly showcased how little Nvidia’s hardware has improved in one generation and relies on software to make up the gaps.
But Nvidia had other plans.
Here are the tactics that Nvidia reportedly just used to throw us off the 5060’s true scent, as individually described by
GamersNexus
,
VideoCardz
,
Hardware Unboxed
,
GameStar.de
,
Digital Foundry
, and more:
Nvidia decided to launch its RTX 5060 on May 19th, when most reviewers would be at Computex in Taipei, Taiwan, rather than at their test beds at home.
Even if reviewers already had a GPU in hand before then, Nvidia cut off most reviewers’ ability to test the RTX 5060 before May 19th by refusing to provide drivers until the card went on sale. (Gaming GPUs don’t really work without them.)
And yet Nvidia allowed
specific
, cherry-picked reviewers to have early drivers anyhow
if
they agreed to a borderline unethical deal: they could only test five specific games, at 1080p resolution, with fixed graphics settings, against two weaker GPUs (the 3060 and 2060 Super) where the new card would be sure to win.
In some cases, Nvidia threatened to withhold future access unless reviewers published apples-to-oranges benchmark charts showing how the RTX 5060’s
“fake frames” MFG tech
can produce more frames than earlier GPUs without it.
Some reviewers apparently took Nvidia up on that proposition, leading to day-one “previews” where the charts looked positively stacked in the 5060’s favor:
GameStar.de revealed Nvidia’s alleged meddling, but it complied anyhow.
Image:
GameStar.de
“Exclusive Preview: I Played with the RTX 5060 Before Anyone Else, and It’s Sure to Make a Big Splash!” is the headline on this
JeuxVideo
story, according to Google Translate.
Image:
JeuxVideo.com
But the reality, according to reviews that have since hit the web, is that the RTX 5060 often fails to beat a four-year-old RTX 3060 Ti, frequently fails to beat a four-year-old 3070, and can sometimes get upstaged by
Intel’s cheaper $250 B580
.
And yet, the 5060’s lackluster improvements are overshadowed by a juicier story: inexplicably, Nvidia decided to threaten
GamersNexus’
future access over its GPU coverage. Yes, the same
GamersNexus
that’s
developed
a
staunch
reputation
for defending consumers from predatory behavior, and just last month published
a report on “GPU shrinkflation”
that accused Nvidia of misleading marketing. Bad move!
In a
22-minute video
, GN claims Nvidia threatened to cut off access to Nvidia’s cooling and latency experts unless GN agreed to do the thing you see in the charts above — compare cards with fake frames to cards without. GN claims it has the recorded phone conversations to prove it, which are likely legal because Nvidia was recording them too.
“Just to be clear, Nvidia, I am prepared to release them,” GN editor-in-chief Steve Burke threatened.
Recording every conversation isn’t how companies and reviewers normally operate. There’s been a serious breakdown in trust if we find ourselves here!
Nvidia is within its rights to withhold access, of course. Nvidia doesn’t have to send out graphics cards or grant interviews. It’ll only do it if it’s good for business.
But the unspoken covenant of product reviews is that the press,
as a whole
, gets a chance to warn the public if a movie, video game, or GPU is not worth their money. It works both ways: the media also gets the chance to warn that a product is so good you might want to line up in advance. That unspoken rule is what Nvidia is trampling here.
Nvidia is trampling an unspoken rule
On Wed

data.title: Camera reviews are not only pointless, but are also kind of rigged
data.author: gslin
data.article_summary: 本文批评了当前的相机评测，认为它们不仅毫无意义，而且受到炒作影响。作者以PetaPixel对Fuji X half相机的评测为例，指出该相机虽然有独特设计（如垂直取景器和LCD），但实质上是形式大于内容。相机具备1800万像素的一英寸传感器和32mm镜头，但其创新设计并未真正提升实用性。作者引用相机专家Thom Hogan的观点，认为相机公司虽尝试突破传统设计，但过多注重风格而非实质。文章还揭露了评测者往往因利益关系而无法提供真实评价，建议消费者警惕这些炒作，除非有人自费购买并长期使用后分享真实感受，否则不必理会这些评测。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：广告模式的转变，尤其是在视频游戏等产品中，从传统广告向网红营销的转变。

不同观点：
• 观点一：[mnky9800n] 认为，广告模式已经从传统的广告形式转向了以网红为主要渠道的营销方式，尤其是在视频游戏行业中。这表明网红营销已经成为一种广泛应用的广告策略。
  
• 观点二：未直接提及，但隐含的对立观点可能是，传统广告仍然在某些领域或产品中具有不可替代的作用，并非所有行业或产品都完全转向了网红营销。

补充讨论：
• 论据：[mnky9800n] 提到视频游戏等产品作为例子，说明这些行业已经普遍采用网红营销，可能因为网红营销更具互动性和真实性，能够更有效地吸引年轻消费者。
  
• 争议焦点：传统广告与网红营销的有效性对比，特别是在不同产品和行业中的适用性。传统广告可能在覆盖面和品牌信任建立上有其独特优势，而网红营销则在精准投放和互动性上更具优势。

• 其他值得注意的讨论点：网红营销的崛起是否意味着传统广告的消亡，或者二者是否可以并存并互为补充，这也是一个潜在的讨论方向。

44103620.article_content:
May 23, 2025
Camera reviews
are not only pointless
, but are
also kind of rigged
. And there is no better testimonial for this camera hype machine than the “
review
” of F
uji X half camera
by PetaPixel. Fuji X half camera is a camera that has vertical optical viewfinder and a vertical rear LCD. It has an 18-megapixel one-inch sensor, an equivalent of 32mm lens, and uses a 3:4 aspect ratio.
The camera might be a nod to the TikTok-ing of visual culture, but it is as style over substance as you can get. Yes, Fuji is trying hard to experiment with form factors and leaning in on its film heritage. And yes, that’s a good thing. However, that doesn’t necessarily mean it is beneficial. I know it is hard to convince many, but from my perspective, I only expect camera phones to become even more powerful. I will let a real camera guru whose opinion I trust speak.
“The Sigma bf camera was a rethink at simplification of the photo capture process. The Fujifilm X half is a whimsical impression of what photo taking should be like,” writes
Thom Hogan
. “It’s nice that we’re getting camera companies thinking outside the box they’re in, but there’s a lot of style over substance going on in these new designs.”
He is right. However, you won’t hear that from the influencer machine that hypes up camera products. I have said it before, and will say it again—these camera reviewers are pretty useless. They can never speak the truth. After all, they need the cameras to create content for their websites and social media channels. And those who don’t need the cameras to stay in business get bought by free kits. Hasselblad has been buying attention by giving free travel photography kits to YouTubers, who frankly would have never bought any of that gear.
Like I keep saying, camera reviews are worthless. Unless someone pays for their camera, uses it for a few months, and shares their honest thoughts, there is no need to pay any attention to them or what they have to say. More likely than not, they are part of the hype machine.
May 23, 2025. San Francisco.

data.title: Open Source Society University – Path to a free self-taught education in CS
data.author: saikatsg
data.article_summary: OSSU计算机科学课程是一个免费的自学计算机科学课程，旨在提供全面的计算机科学教育，适合已有其他领域教育背景的学习者。课程分为入门CS、核心CS、高级CS和最终项目四个部分，学习者可以根据自己的时间和进度选择单独或小组学习，建议按顺序完成核心CS课程。整个学习过程大约需要2年，每周投入约20小时。大多数课程材料免费，但部分课程的作业和测试可能收费。学习者可使用提供的电子表格规划学习进度，并通过全球学习者社区获得支持。最终项目用于展示和巩固所学知识。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：开源自学大学（OSSU）及其与传统计算机科学教育的比较，自学与学位教育的优劣，职业发展中的网络与机会

不同观点：
• [sulikns] 认为OSSU提供了高质量且结构良好的课程，尤其是对于那些无法获得优质教育资源的人来说，这是一个极好的机会。他通过OSSU重新学习数学和编程，并计划通过贡献开源项目来回馈社会，而不是立即寻求工作。

• [waciuma] 强调OSSU社区和网络的重要性，鼓励有经验的工程师加入并帮助学习者。他指出，社区活动如定期编程、答疑和每周例会都是完整教育的一部分。

• [fzwang] 指出自学路径的优缺点。虽然自学可以更快地学习相关知识，但缺乏学位可能会在求职中造成障碍，特别是在“ signaling”和网络方面。他建议自学者从一开始就要努力克服这些挑战。

• [elpatokamo] 分享了自己选择OSSU而非其他教育选项的经历，并表示OSSU对他的职业和个人幸福都有积极影响。

• [theusus] 推荐了另一个自学网站（teachyourselfcs.com），认为这是一个更好的选择。

• [iamleppert] 以自身20多年的行业经验为例，指出自学者可能无法进入某些顶级公司和岗位，且在薪酬和职业稳定性方面可能面临劣势。他建议如果有条件，还是应该选择正规教育。

• [akshitgaur2005] 作为一名大学在校生，他询问是否应更关注项目经验还是继续OSSU课程，或者两者兼顾。

• [aardvark179] 讨论了学位作为一种“ shibboleth”的作用，认为学位可以减少招聘者的一些疑问，但自学者可以通过实际项目和网络来弥补这一不足。

• [AstroBen] 质疑OSSU中“免费和开源”的限制是否会限制其发展，认为认真自学者应愿意为优质材料投资。

• [globalnode] 认为学位是一块敲门砖，可以弥补社交方面的不足，而自学者需要更强的社交能力或运气。

• [oleks] 作为一名课程设计者，表示希望自己设计的课程能被列入OSSU这样的列表中，并提到ACM/IEEE-CS/AAAI的计算机科学课程标准。

• [fedeb95] 认为OSSU为已有CS知识的人提供了很好的参考，但希望资源不要仅限于YouTube。

• [epolanski] 指出讨论中双方的防御性态度有些令人遗憾。

• [jbverschoor] 提到Saylor Academy作为一个免费资源，可以获得学术学分，但其内容较为密集和传统。

• [Havoc] 质疑自学的最终目的，认为社区大学的教育可能更有助于就业，如果目标是赚钱，可能应选择其他更直接的路径。

补充讨论：
- OSSU的课程质量和结构被广泛认可，尤其对于教育资源匮乏的地区。
- 自学路径的职业发展限制和网络重要性是讨论的焦点，特别是在顶级公司和岗位的准入方面。
- 学位作为“敲门砖”和减少招聘者疑问的作用被多次提及。
- 自学者需要更强的社交能力和网络来弥补学位缺乏的劣势。
- 不同的自学资源和路径被推荐和比较，如teachyourselfcs.com和Saylor Academy。

争议焦点：
- 自学路径与学位教育在职业发展中的优劣对比，特别是在顶级公司和岗位的准入和职业稳定性方面。
- OSSU和其他自学资源中免费和开源材料的限制是否会影响其发展。

Summary
The OSSU curriculum is a
complete education in computer science
using online materials.
It's not merely for career training or professional development.
It's for those who want a proper,
well-rounded
grounding in concepts fundamental to all computing disciplines,
and for those who have the discipline, will, and (most importantly!) good habits to obtain this education largely on their own,
but with support from a worldwide community of fellow learners.
It is designed according to the degree requirements of undergraduate computer science majors, minus general education (non-CS) requirements,
as it is assumed most of the people following this curriculum are already educated outside the field of CS.
The courses themselves are among the very best in the world, often coming from Harvard, Princeton, MIT, etc.,
but specifically chosen to meet the following criteria.
Courses must
:
Be open for enrollment
Run regularly (ideally in self-paced format, otherwise running multiple times per year)
Be of generally high quality in teaching materials and pedagogical principles
Match the curricular standards of the
CS 2013
: Curriculum Guidelines for Undergraduate Degree Programs in Computer Science
When no course meets the above criteria, the coursework is supplemented with a book.
When there are courses or books that don't fit into the curriculum but are otherwise of high quality,
they belong in
extras/courses
or
extras/readings
.
Organization
. The curriculum is designed as follows:
Intro CS
: for students to try out CS and see if it's right for them
Core CS
: corresponds roughly to the first three years of a computer science curriculum, taking classes that all majors would be required to take
Advanced CS
: corresponds roughly to the final year of a computer science curriculum, taking electives according to the student's interests
Final Project
: a project for students to validate, consolidate, and display their knowledge, to be evaluated by their peers worldwide
Duration
. It is possible to finish within about 2 years if you plan carefully and devote roughly 20 hours/week to your studies. Learners can use
this spreadsheet
to estimate their end date. Make a copy and input your start date and expected hours per week in the
Timeline
sheet. As you work through courses you can enter your actual course completion dates in the
Curriculum Data
sheet and get updated completion estimates.
Warning:
While the spreadsheet is a useful tool to estimate the time you need to complete this curriculum, it may not always be up-to-date with the curriculum. Use the
OSSU CS website
or
the repo
to see what courses to do.
Cost
. All or nearly all course material is available for free. However, some courses may charge money for assignments/tests/projects to be graded.
Note that both
Coursera
and
edX
offer financial aid.
Decide how much or how little to spend based on your own time and budget;
just remember that you can't purchase success!
Process
. Students can work through the curriculum alone or in groups, in order or out of order.
We recommend doing all courses in Core CS, only skipping a course when you are certain that you've already learned the material previously.
For simplicity, we recommend working through courses (especially Core CS) in order from top to bottom. Some students choose to study multiple courses at a time in order to vary the material they are working on in a day/week. A popular option is to take the math courses in parallel with the introductory courses. Course prerequisites are listed to help you determine if you are prepared for a given course.
Courses in Advanced CS are electives. Choose one subject (e.g. Advanced programming) you want to become an expert in and take all the courses under that heading. You can also create your own custom subject; the Discord community may provide feedback on your planned subject.

• [oleks] 作为一名课程设计者，表示希望自己设计的课程能被列入OSSU这样的列表中，并提到ACM/IEEE-CS/AAAI的计算机科学课程标准。

• [fedeb95] 认为OSSU为已有CS知识的人提供了很好的参考，但希望资源不要仅限于YouTube。

• [epolanski] 指出讨论中双方的防御性态度有些令人遗憾。

• [jbverschoor] 提到Saylor Academy作为一个免费资源，可以获得学术学分，但其内容较为密集和传统。

• [Havoc] 质疑自学的最终目的，认为社区大学的教育可能更有助于就业，如果目标是赚钱，可能应选择其他更直接的路径。

补充讨论：
- OSSU的课程质量和结构被广泛认可，尤其对于教育资源匮乏的地区。
- 自学路径的职业发展限制和网络重要性是讨论的焦点，特别是在顶级公司和岗位的准入方面。
- 学位作为“敲门砖”和减少招聘者疑问的作用被多次提及。
- 自学者需要更强的社交能力和网络来弥补学位缺乏的劣势。
- 不同的自学资源和路径被推荐和比较，如teachyourselfcs.com和Saylor Academy。

争议焦点：
- 自学路径与学位教育在职业发展中的优劣对比，特别是在顶级公司和岗位的准入和职业稳定性方面。
- OSSU和其他自学资源中免费和开源材料的限制是否会影响其发展。

NEWSLETTER
He Has Powered His House for 8 Years Using Laptop Batteries
Technologies
By Clément Pessaux
The May 26, 2025
Can we really turn waste into a sustainable source of energy? Glubux, a daring internet user, took on the challenge with 1,000 used batteries. Discover how he has been powering his home for 8 years thanks to his ingenuity!
Have you ever thought about what happens to your used batteries once they die? Glubux not only thought about the question but also took action! With a thousand batteries out of use, this daring internet user achieved the unthinkable: turning a pile of waste into a sustainable source of energy. Eight years now that his home has been bathed in light, powered by this extraordinary invention. Let’s dive together into Glubux’s electrifying adventure and discover how he turned the impossible into a shining reality.
Rethinking our electronic waste: an inspiring solution
Every year, millions of tons of electronic waste accumulate worldwide. But some curious minds, like Glubux, go further and decide to give them a second life. This internet user came up with a bright idea to recycle 1,000 laptop batteries and transform his daily life. The result? A house powered by energy for 8 years!
A project born from a clever mind overflowing with ingenuity
Glubux, known on various online forums, started his project in 2016 with a simple idea: reuse used laptop batteries to create an energy self-consumption system. By recovering functional cells from batteries destined for the trash, he gradually built a solution capable of powering his entire home. But how does such a feat work?
Recycled batteries and well-combined solar panels
At the heart of this system are over 1,000 laptop batteries, meticulously disassembled and reconditioned. These batteries, connected to a 7,000 Wc solar installation, allow Glubux to produce and store clean energy. Imagine: where these batteries were once destined to pollute, they are now a pillar of an autonomous house! A beautiful demonstration of what the circular economy entails.
To power his home, Glubux relied on widely accessible tools, from recycling electronic components to technical knowledge gathered through forums like France PowerWall DIY. A method that proves that innovation is not reserved for laboratories or big companies.
8 years without a hitch: an ever-evolving adventure
Behind the success of this project lies an unwavering determination to overcome technical challenges. Glubux had to solve several problems over the years: cell balancing, electrical safety, and storage management. But his system keeps improving. For example, his energy production capacity has increased from 7 kWh to 56 kWh. Impressive, isn’t it?
In parallel, all this comes with a drastic reduction in his energy bill. Despite a significant initial investment (estimated at around 2,500 euros), Glubux already believes he has amortized his system, thanks in large part to batteries obtained for free from individuals or companies.
An inspiration for the future?
With this system that combines innovation and recycling, Glubux shows a concrete example of what energy self-consumption can be. In a context where the European Parliament is working to limit electronic waste, these initiatives remind us that another path is possible. So, who knows? Perhaps the next used battery you come across will also have a second life.

data.title: Cows get GPS collars to stop them falling in river
data.author: zeristor
data.article_summary: 剑桥市议会为防止牛只在放牧季节落入剑河，给牛佩戴了GPS项圈。这些太阳能项圈在牛接近河边时会发出高音并给予轻微电击，以阻止其继续前进。此前，每年有多达四头牛在放牧季节落入河中，市议会需花费约1万英镑打捞。新技术的使用旨在减少这一开支。同时，市议会承诺继续资助放牧传统，并强调此举对市民和游客的特殊意义。动物救援队仍会在牛遇到困难时进行救助。

• amelius：提出另一个解决方案，即在河床上放生一些海龟，附上一个幽默视频链接。

• gadders：分享邻居的牛因为滑倒无法回到坡上，最终需要消防部门动物救援单位帮助。
• sharklasers123：赞赏虚拟围栏技术，提到噪音和振动，并假设使用HalterHQ的技术，可以用来引导牛去挤奶或虚拟休息围栏。
• ViscountPenguin：提到当地议会使用这些技术让牛在Wanstead公园放牧，认为牛很可爱。
• jll29：表示正在寻找“geofencing”的例子，这篇文章正好提供了帮助。
• MarkusWandel：对高科技解决方案表示怀疑，认为过去的低科技解决方案如围栏就足够了。
• aa-jv：赞赏剑桥的绿地和环境，提到牛只是偶尔打扰，整体享受城市氛围。
• mschuster91：提到德国政治中关于“不需要在每个牛设施上安装5G”的观点，认为现代农业需要良好的移动连接，并建议使用临时电围栏和关闭阿尔卑斯山地区 gates 的习惯。
• josefritzishere：简单质疑剑桥是否没人会建围栏。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及到技术的实用性、历史背景、不同地区的管理方法以及幽默和文化参考。
• 争议焦点在于高科技解决方案是否必要，例如GPS和虚拟围栏技术的准确性和实用性，以及传统方法如物理围栏的有效性。
• 不同地区如澳大利亚和德国对牛群管理的不同方法也被比较和讨论。

44079729.article_content:
Image source,
PA Media
Image caption,
Cattle graze on commons including Midsummer Common in the centre of Cambridge
Published
20 May 2025
Cows have been fitted with GPS collars to try to stop them falling into a river.
Cambridge City Council said up to four ended up in the River Cam during grazing season between April and October each year.
Solar-powered GPS devices emit a high-pitched sound as the animal moves through a boundary zone towards the water, with a mild electric pulse delivered if it fails to turn around.
The council spends about Â£10,000 a year funding a team to recover cattle from the river, and said the new technology would help with costs.
Image source,
PA Media
Cows can be seen roaming on council-owned green spaces such as Midsummer and Stourbridge commons, Coe Fen, Lammas Land and Sheep's Green.
A team of animal rescuers employed by the council, known as pinders, are deployed if an animal gets into difficulty, such as getting stuck in the River Cam.
Last year, Cambridge City Council carried out a consultation on whether to pass the cost of the out-of-hours animal rescue service on to graziers.
Image source,
PA Media
Image caption,
The tradition of grazing cattle on common land goes back to the Middle Ages
However, the authority has given reassurance - after public support for cows grazing on the commons - that it will "continue to fund grazing" and has "improved animal welfare with a technology that keeps the cows from falling into the river".
Martin Smart, executive councillor for open space and city services, said: "The council recognises the symbolic importance of the cows grazing on the commons.
"This is a special and unique feature of the city that is much loved by residents and visitors alike."

• chaps：指出GPS用于牛跟踪早在20世纪80年代就有了，并提到一些公司后来转向人类踝 monitor 跟踪，认为GPS并不那么准确。
• zeristor：提供信息的来源，认为信息的来源本身很有趣。
• amelius：提出另一个解决方案，即在河床上放生一些海龟，附上一个幽默视频链接。
• emmelaich：提到一本经典的儿童书籍，内容关于一只掉进运河的牛。
• scowby：提到澳大利亚的虚拟围栏研究，已商业化，指出远程管理牧群的好处，包括定义避免区域如河流和池塘。
• gadders：分享邻居的牛因为滑倒无法回到坡上，最终需要消防部门动物救援单位帮助。
• sharklasers123：赞赏虚拟围栏技术，提到噪音和振动，并假设使用HalterHQ的技术，可以用来引导牛去挤奶或虚拟休息围栏。
• ViscountPenguin：提到当地议会使用这些技术让牛在Wanstead公园放牧，认为牛很可爱。
• jll29：表示正在寻找“geofencing”的例子，这篇文章正好提供了帮助。
• MarkusWandel：对高科技解决方案表示怀疑，认为过去的低科技解决方案如围栏就足够了。
• aa-jv：赞赏剑桥的绿地和环境，提到牛只是偶尔打扰，整体享受城市氛围。
• mschuster91：提到德国政治中关于“不需要在每个牛设施上安装5G”的观点，认为现代农业需要良好的移动连接，并建议使用临时电围栏和关闭阿尔卑斯山地区 gates 的习惯。
• josefritzishere：简单质疑剑桥是否没人会建围栏。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及到技术的实用性、历史背景、不同地区的管理方法以及幽默和文化参考。
• 争议焦点在于高科技解决方案是否必要，例如GPS和虚拟围栏技术的准确性和实用性，以及传统方法如物理围栏的有效性。
• 不同地区如澳大利亚和德国对牛群管理的不同方法也被比较和讨论。

• [pabs3] 的评论提供了技术细节，指出NXDOMAIN响应，可能是DNS配置错误或域名解析服务中断。

data.title: Estonia eschews phone bans in schools and takes leap into AI
data.author: atlasunshrugged
data.article_summary: Estonia, a top performer in European education, integrates smartphones and artificial intelligence (AI) into its schools instead of banning devices like in some other countries. Through the new "AI Leap" initiative, Estonia aims to equip students and teachers with world-class AI tools and skills, starting with older students and expanding nationally by 2027. The government is partnering with OpenAI to implement these tools, focusing on self-directed learning, digital ethics, and educational equity. Unlike nations concerned about the impact of screens on concentration, Estonia sees digital tools as key to its success, encouraging their use for both learning and civic engagement, such as online voting. The country's forward-thinking approach also anticipates a shift from traditional learning models to ones that prioritize higher cognitive skills, leveraging AI to handle routine tasks.
